description: Name of the lead reinsurer on the treaty panel who sets terms and conditions. The lead reinsurer's agreement is typically required for claims and endorsements.
reference: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; Lloyd's Market Practice; NAIC Schedule F

description: Percentage of the treaty limit subscribed by the lead reinsurer. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.2500 = 25% line). Total panel shares must sum to 100%.
Maximum monetary amount the reinsurer is obligated to pay under this treaty layer. For XOL, this is the layer width above the retention/attachment point.
reference: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; NAIC Schedule F; IAIS

description: Lower bound of the loss corridor (as a percentage of subject premium) within which Pc_Insurance retains losses in a stop-loss or aggregate structure. Null if not applicable.
Upper bound of the loss corridor (as a percentage of subject premium) above which reinsurance coverage resumes in a stop-loss or aggregate structure. Null if not applicable.
Minimum reinsurance premium guaranteed to the reinsurer regardless of subject premium volume. Protects the reinsurer against low-volume treaty years.

business_glossary_term: National Association of Insurance Commissioners (NAIC) Reinsurer Code
description: Five-digit NAIC company code assigned to the reinsurer, used for statutory Schedule F reporting and regulatory identification of the reinsurance counterparty.
reference: NAIC Schedule F; NAIC Company Database

description: Description of the perils or causes of loss covered by the treaty (e.g., 'All Natural Perils', 'Named Windstorm and Earthquake', 'Fire and Allied Lines'). Free-text or coded.
reference: ISO/Verisk; Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; NAIC Schedule F

description: Indicates whether the reinsurance placement is a treaty (automatic, portfolio-wide) or facultative (FAC) certificate covering a specific risk or policy.
Probable Maximum Loss (PML) estimate for the subject portfolio covered by this treaty, used to size the reinsurance limit and assess adequacy of protection.
reference: ISO/Verisk AIR/RMS CAT Models; A.M. Best; Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster

description: Percentage of reinsurer profit returned to Pc_Insurance as a profit commission when the treaty loss ratio falls below a defined threshold. Incentivizes underwriting quality.
Loss ratio threshold below which the profit commission mechanism is triggered. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.6500 = 65% loss ratio). Null if no profit commission applies.
Name of the overarching reinsurance program to which this treaty layer belongs (e.g., 'Property CAT Program 2024'). Groups related layers for program-level reporting.
Rate on Line (ROL) expressed as a percentage of the treaty limit, representing the reinsurance premium as a proportion of the limit purchased. Key pricing metric for XOL treaties.
reference: ISO/Verisk; Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; Lloyd's Market Practice

description: Number of reinstatements available to restore the treaty limit after a loss occurrence. Common in CAT XL treaties. Zero indicates no reinstatements permitted.
reference: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; ISO/Verisk CAT XL Market Practice

description: Percentage of the original reinsurance premium charged to reinstate the treaty limit after a loss. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 1.0000 = 100% pro-rata reinstatement premium).
reference: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; ISO/Verisk CAT XL Market Practice

description: The monetary amount or percentage of risk that Pc_Insurance retains before the reinsurance treaty responds. For XOL, this is the per-occurrence or per-risk retention (attachment point).
reference: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; NAIC Schedule F; IAIS Reinsurance Standards

description: Indicates whether the retention is expressed as a fixed monetary amount (e.g., SIR or attachment point in USD) or as a percentage of the risk (used in QS treaties).
Defines the premium base to which the treaty rate or cession percentage is applied: Gross Written Premium (GWP), Net Written Premium (NWP), Earned Premium (EP), or Written Premium (WP).
reference: NAIC Schedule F; SAP/STAT; Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster

description: Geographic scope of risks covered by the treaty (e.g., 'USA and Canada', 'Worldwide Excluding War Zones'). Defines the territorial limits of reinsurance protection.
reference: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; ISO/Verisk; NAIC Schedule F

description: Descriptive business name of the reinsurance treaty (e.g., 'Property CAT XL Layer 1 2024') used for identification in bordereaux and management reporting.
Externally-known alphanumeric identifier assigned to the reinsurance treaty or facultative (FAC) certificate by the reinsurance management system or lead reinsurer.
reference: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; SICS; NAIC Annual Statement Instructions

description: Current lifecycle state of the reinsurance treaty: DRAFT (in negotiation), BOUND (signed/agreed), ACTIVE (in-force), EXPIRED, CANCELLED, or SUSPENDED.
reference: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; SICS; NAIC Schedule F

description: Classification of the reinsurance structure: Excess of Loss (XOL), Quota Share (QS), Catastrophe Excess of Loss (CAT XL), Facultative (FAC), CAT Bond, Stop Loss, or Aggregate.
reference: ISO/Verisk; NAIC Schedule F; IAIS Reinsurance Standards

description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the reinsurance treaty record in the reinsurance management system. Supports audit trail and change tracking requirements.
Unique surrogate identifier for each retention/limit layer record within a reinsurance treaty or facultative certificate structure.
reference: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; SICS Reinsurance Management System

description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this layer (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Supports multi-currency treaty structures.
reference: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; NAIC Annual Statement Instructions; IFRS 17

description: Foreign key linking to riskexposure.insured_location. Business justification: Treaty layers (especially CAT XOL) are priced against location exposure schedules.
NAIC or internal Line of Business code identifying the class of business covered by this treaty layer (e.g., Commercial Auto, GL, Property, WC). Supports statutory reporting.
reference: NAIC Line of Business Codes; ISO/Verisk; Statutory Accounting Principles (SAP)

description: Reference to the parent reinsurance treaty or facultative certificate to which this layer belongs.
reference: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; SICS Reinsurance Management System

description: Final reinsurance premium after year-end adjustment reconciling deposit premium against actual subject premium earned. Reflects true cost of the layer for the period.
reference: NAIC Schedule F; Statutory Accounting Principles (SAP); Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster

description: Maximum total reinsurer liability across all occurrences within the treaty year for this layer. Caps cumulative reinsurer exposure on aggregate XOL structures.
reference: ISO/Verisk Aggregate XOL Standards; NAIC Schedule F; Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster

description: Cumulative loss amount the cedant must retain before the aggregate XOL layer responds. Used in aggregate stop-loss and aggregate XOL treaty structures.
reference: ISO/Verisk Aggregate XOL Standards; Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; NAIC Schedule F

business_glossary_term: Allocated Loss Adjustment Expense (ALAE) Included Indicator
description: Indicates whether Allocated Loss Adjustment Expense (ALAE) is included within the layer limit and attachment point calculations for this treaty layer.
reference: NAIC Schedule F; Statutory Accounting Principles (SAP); Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster

description: The loss amount at which this reinsurance layer begins to respond. For XOL structures, losses must exceed this threshold before the reinsurer pays. Also known as the retention.
reference: ISO/Verisk XOL Structuring Standards; Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; NAIC Schedule F

description: Maximum reinsurer liability per defined catastrophe event under a CAT XL layer. Distinct from per-risk occurrence limit; applies to accumulation of losses from a single CAT event.
reference: ISO/Verisk CAT Modeling Standards; NAIC Schedule F; Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster

description: Percentage of ceded premium returned to the cedant by the reinsurer as a ceding commission to cover acquisition and administrative costs on QS treaties.
reference: NAIC Schedule F; Statutory Accounting Principles (SAP); Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster

description: Percentage of risk ceded to reinsurers under a Quota Share (QS) layer. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.3000 = 30%). Applicable to QS and proportional treaty structures.
reference: NAIC Schedule F; Statutory Accounting Principles (SAP); Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster

description: Timestamp when this treaty layer record was first created in the reinsurance management system. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
reference: SOX Section 404; NAIC Data Governance Standards; Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster

description: Provisional premium paid to the reinsurer at inception of the treaty period, subject to adjustment at year-end based on actual subject premium earned.
reference: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; NAIC Schedule F; Statutory Accounting Principles (SAP)

description: Date on which this treaty layer becomes operative and eligible to accept ceded risk and premium.
reference: NAIC Reinsurance Accounting Standards; Statutory Accounting Principles (SAP)

description: Free-text summary of key exclusions applicable to this layer (e.g., nuclear, cyber, war, NBCR). Supports underwriting review and reinsurer communication.
reference: ISO/Verisk Reinsurance Wording Standards; Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster

description: The loss level at which this layer is fully exhausted, calculated as attachment point plus layer limit. Marks the top of the layer in the reinsurance tower.
reference: ISO/Verisk Reinsurance Structuring Standards; Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster

description: Date on which this treaty layer ceases to be operative. Null for evergreen or continuous treaty layers.
reference: NAIC Reinsurance Accounting Standards; Statutory Accounting Principles (SAP)

description: Number of consecutive hours defining the event window for CAT XL loss aggregation. Losses occurring within this window are treated as a single occurrence (e.g., 72 or 168 hours).
reference: ISO/Verisk CAT XL Structuring Standards; Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster

description: The reference year used as the base for the index or stability clause adjustment. Applicable only when index_clause is true.
reference: ISO/Verisk Reinsurance Structuring Standards; Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster

description: Indicates whether an index or stability clause applies to this layer, adjusting the attachment point and limit for inflation over the treaty period.
reference: ISO/Verisk Reinsurance Structuring Standards; Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster

description: Specifies how LAE is handled within this layer. INCLUDED=LAE erodes the limit, EXCLUDED=LAE outside limit, PRO_RATA=LAE shared proportionally with losses.
reference: NAIC Schedule F; Statutory Accounting Principles (SAP); ISO/Verisk

description: Maximum amount the reinsurer will pay for losses within this layer per occurrence or per risk. Defines the top of the layer in the XOL tower.
reference: ISO/Verisk XOL Structuring Standards; Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; NAIC Schedule F

description: Descriptive business name for the layer (e.g., 'First XOL Layer', 'QS Tranche A', 'CAT XL Working Layer') used in bordereaux and reinsurer communications.
reference: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; SICS Reinsurance Management System

description: Sequential position of this layer within the treaty structure (e.g., 1 = first XOL layer, 2 = second XOL layer). Drives ordering in multi-layer tower analysis.
reference: ISO/Verisk Reinsurance Structuring Standards; Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster

description: Current lifecycle state of the treaty layer. Drives whether cessions and premium calculations are applied against this layer.
reference: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; NAIC Annual Statement Instructions

description: Classification of the reinsurance layer structure. XOL=Excess of Loss, QS=Quota Share, CAT XL=Catastrophe Excess of Loss, FAC=Facultative, AGGREGATE_XL=Aggregate Excess of Loss.
reference: NAIC Reinsurance Accounting Standards; ISO/Verisk; Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster

description: Trigger basis determining how losses are measured and applied to this layer. OCCURRENCE=per event, RISK=per insured risk, AGGREGATE=cumulative annual, CLAIMS_MADE=claims-made trigger.
reference: ISO/Verisk Reinsurance Structuring Standards; NAIC Schedule F; Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster

description: Ceiling ceding commission rate applicable under a sliding scale commission arrangement. The cedant receives at most this rate when loss ratio is at its lowest.
reference: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; NAIC Schedule F; Statutory Accounting Principles (SAP)

description: Floor ceding commission rate applicable under a sliding scale commission arrangement. The cedant receives at least this rate regardless of loss ratio.
reference: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; NAIC Schedule F; Statutory Accounting Principles (SAP)

description: Minimum reinsurance premium guaranteed to the reinsurer for this layer regardless of subject premium volume. Protects reinsurer against low-volume treaty years.
reference: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; NAIC Schedule F; Statutory Accounting Principles (SAP)

description: Maximum reinsurer liability per single occurrence or event under this layer. Distinct from the aggregate annual limit. Applies to per-occurrence XOL and CAT XL structures.
reference: ISO/Verisk XOL Structuring Standards; NAIC Schedule F; Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster

description: Basis used to size the layer relative to the cedant's exposure. PML=Probable Maximum Loss, TIV=Total Insured Value, EML=Estimated Maximum Loss, MFL=Maximum Foreseeable Loss.
reference: ISO/Verisk PML Standards; A.M. Best Reinsurance Adequacy; Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster

description: Percentage of reinsurer profit returned to the cedant as a profit commission under proportional QS layers. Incentivizes cedant loss control.
reference: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; NAIC Schedule F; Statutory Accounting Principles (SAP)

description: Number of reinstatements available for this layer after a loss exhausts the limit. Common in CAT XL structures where one or two reinstatements are negotiated.
reference: ISO/Verisk CAT XL Structuring Standards; Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster

description: Percentage of the original layer premium charged to reinstate the full limit after a loss. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 1.0000 = 100% pro-rata reinstatement).
reference: ISO/Verisk CAT XL Structuring Standards; Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster

description: Gross premium ceded to reinsurers for this layer for the treaty period. For XOL layers, derived from ROL times limit; for QS, from cession percentage times subject premium.
reference: NAIC Schedule F; Statutory Accounting Principles (SAP); IFRS 17

description: Rate on Line expressed as a decimal fraction of the layer limit. Used to price non-proportional XOL and CAT XL layers. ROL multiplied by limit yields the reinsurance premium.
reference: ISO/Verisk Rating Standards; Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; A.M. Best Reinsurance Pricing

description: Total percentage of the layer capacity that has been signed by reinsurers at placement. Should sum to 100% for a fully placed layer. Tracks placement completeness.
reference: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; SICS Reinsurance Management System; Lloyd's Market Standards

description: Indicates whether the ceding commission on this QS layer is subject to a sliding scale that varies inversely with the loss ratio, rewarding better underwriting performance.
reference: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; NAIC Schedule F; ISO/Verisk

description: Premium base used to calculate ceded premium for proportional layers. GWP=Gross Written Premium, NWP=Net Written Premium, EP=Earned Premium, WP=Written Premium.
reference: NAIC Schedule F; Statutory Accounting Principles (SAP); Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster

description: Geographic territory covered by this treaty layer (e.g., 'USA', 'USA and Canada', specific state codes). Defines the geographic boundary of reinsurer liability.
reference: NAIC Schedule F; ISO/Verisk; Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster

description: The underwriting or treaty year to which this layer belongs. Used for bordereaux processing, IBNR development, and year-of-account statutory reporting.
reference: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions; Statutory Accounting Principles (SAP); IFRS 17

description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this treaty layer record. Used for change tracking, audit compliance, and incremental data pipeline processing.
reference: SOX Section 404; NAIC Data Governance Standards; Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster

description: Percentage of the layer capacity initially offered and written by reinsurers before signing. May differ from signed line if the market is oversubscribed or undersubscribed.
reference: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; Lloyd's Market Standards; SICS Reinsurance Management System

description: Unique surrogate identifier for each treaty-reinsurer participation record in the reinsurance panel.
Reference to the reinsurer party entity participating in this treaty panel.
Reference to the reinsurance broker who placed this reinsurer's line on the treaty, used for brokerage commission and placement tracking.
reference: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster / SICS; NAIC Reinsurance Intermediary Model Act

description: Reference to the parent reinsurance treaty to which this reinsurer participates.
Reference to the reinsurer who replaced this participant on the treaty panel following a withdrawal or capacity reduction.
A.M. Best financial strength rating of the reinsurer at the time of treaty placement, used for credit quality and security assessment.
reference: A.M. Best Rating Services; NAIC Credit for Reinsurance Model Law

description: Percentage of ceded premium payable to the reinsurance broker for placing this reinsurer's line on the treaty.
reference: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster / SICS; NAIC Reinsurance Intermediary Model Act

description: Total Loss Adjustment Expense (LAE) ceded to this reinsurer under this treaty participation for the current treaty period.
reference: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster / SICS; NAIC Schedule F; SAP/STAT LAE Reporting

description: Total losses ceded to this reinsurer under this treaty participation for the current treaty period, in the treaty currency.
reference: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster / SICS; NAIC Schedule F; SAP/STAT Reinsurance Accounting

description: Total premium ceded to this reinsurer under this treaty participation for the current treaty period, in the treaty currency.
reference: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster / SICS; NAIC Schedule F; SAP/STAT Reinsurance Accounting

description: Actual amount of collateral currently held from this reinsurer (letters of credit, trust funds, funds withheld) for credit for reinsurance.
reference: NAIC Credit for Reinsurance Model Law; SAP/STAT Schedule F; State DOI Regulations

description: Amount of collateral required from this reinsurer to support credit for reinsurance, based on authorization status and applicable regulations.
reference: NAIC Credit for Reinsurance Model Law; State DOI Regulations; SAP/STAT

description: Type of collateral arrangement held from this reinsurer (e.g., letter of credit, trust fund, funds withheld, cash deposit).
reference: NAIC Credit for Reinsurance Model Law; SAP/STAT Schedule F

description: Timestamp when this treaty-reinsurer participation record was first created in the reinsurance management system.
reference: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster / SICS; SOX Audit Trail Requirements

description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which ceded premium, losses, and recoverable balances are denominated for this reinsurer.
reference: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; NAIC SAP Reinsurance Accounting

description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the reinsurer's domicile jurisdiction, used for credit for reinsurance and regulatory reporting.
reference: ISO 3166-1; NAIC Credit for Reinsurance Model Law; State DOI Regulations

description: Date on which this reinsurer's participation in the treaty becomes binding and effective.
reference: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster / SICS; NAIC SAP Reinsurance Standards

description: Date on which this reinsurer's participation in the treaty expires or terminates. Null for open-ended participations.
reference: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster / SICS; NAIC SAP Reinsurance Standards

description: Amount of ceded premium withheld by the cedant from this reinsurer under a funds withheld arrangement, reducing settlement cash flows.
reference: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster / SICS; NAIC SAP Reinsurance Accounting; SAP/STAT

description: Indicates whether this reinsurer is authorized (licensed) in the cedant's domicile state, affecting credit for reinsurance treatment.
reference: NAIC Credit for Reinsurance Model Law; State DOI Regulations

description: Indicates whether this reinsurer holds certified reinsurer status under NAIC Credit for Reinsurance Model Law, enabling reduced collateral requirements.
reference: NAIC Credit for Reinsurance Model Law; State DOI Regulations

description: Indicates whether this reinsurer is the lead underwriter on the treaty panel, responsible for setting terms and conditions.
reference: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster / SICS; Lloyd's Market Placement Standards

description: NAIC-assigned five-digit company code for the reinsurer, used in statutory Schedule F and reinsurance regulatory filings.
reference: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions; NAIC Schedule F

description: The percentage of the treaty capacity initially offered to this reinsurer during placement, before signing adjustments.
reference: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster / SICS; Lloyd's Market Placement Standards

description: The percentage of the total treaty order placed with this reinsurer, reflecting the cedant's actual placement instruction.
reference: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster / SICS; Lloyd's Market Placement Standards

description: Ordering sequence of this reinsurer within the treaty panel, used for bordereaux presentation and cession processing priority.
Free-text notes capturing special conditions, side agreements, or underwriting remarks specific to this reinsurer's participation on the treaty.
Externally-known unique reference number assigned to this reinsurer's line on the treaty, used in bordereaux and cession statements.
Current lifecycle status of the reinsurer's participation on the treaty panel (e.g., active, signed, withdrawn, pending, cancelled, suspended).
reference: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster / SICS; NAIC Reinsurance Reporting

description: Profit commission percentage payable by this reinsurer to the cedant if the treaty produces a profit, per the profit commission formula.
reference: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster / SICS; Lloyd's Market Placement Standards

description: Date as of which the reinsurer's financial strength ratings (A.M. Best, S&P) were captured for this participation record.
reference: A.M. Best Rating Services; S&P Global Ratings; NAIC Credit for Reinsurance Model Law

description: Outstanding reinsurance recoverable balance owed by this reinsurer to the cedant, representing unpaid ceded losses and LAE.
reference: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster / SICS; NAIC Schedule F; SAP/STAT Reinsurance Recoverables

description: Commission percentage payable by this reinsurer to the cedant on ceded premium, applicable for quota share and proportional treaties.
reference: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster / SICS; NAIC SAP Reinsurance Accounting

description: Role of the reinsurer on the treaty panel (e.g., lead, follow, co-reinsurer, fronting, security), indicating their authority and position.
reference: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster / SICS; Lloyd's Market Placement Standards

description: The final signed share percentage allocated to this reinsurer after signing-down of the oversubscribed panel.
reference: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster / SICS; Lloyd's Market Placement Standards; NAIC Reinsurance Reporting

description: Date on which this reinsurer formally signed their line on the treaty, confirming their participation and subscribed share.
reference: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster / SICS; Lloyd's Market Placement Standards

description: Maximum commission percentage under a sliding scale commission arrangement, applied when the loss ratio is at its minimum threshold.
reference: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster / SICS; ISO Reinsurance Placement Standards

description: Minimum commission percentage under a sliding scale commission arrangement, applied when the loss ratio reaches its maximum threshold.
reference: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster / SICS; ISO Reinsurance Placement Standards

description: Standard & Poor's (S&P) financial strength rating of the reinsurer at the time of treaty placement, used for panel security evaluation.
reference: S&P Global Ratings; NAIC Credit for Reinsurance Model Law

description: The reinsurer's confirmed subscribed share of the treaty, representing their proportional participation used for cession and premium allocation.
reference: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster / SICS; NAIC Annual Statement Reinsurance Schedule

description: Timestamp when this treaty-reinsurer participation record was last modified in the reinsurance management system.
reference: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster / SICS; SOX Audit Trail Requirements

description: Date on which this reinsurer withdrew from the treaty panel, if applicable. Null for active participations.
reference: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster / SICS; NAIC Reinsurance Reporting

description: Reason for the reinsurer's withdrawal from the treaty panel (e.g., capacity reduction, credit downgrade, market exit, cedant request).
reference: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster / SICS; NAIC Reinsurance Reporting

description: The percentage of the treaty capacity written (committed) by this reinsurer at the time of placement, prior to signing-down.
reference: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster / SICS; Lloyd's Market Placement Standards
